answer: Pay propagation rewards only for real downstream activity, never for merely existing. When an identity invites others, its referral override is funded strictly from the emission those recruits earn by doing graded work. A fabricated sub-tree can wander the ledger and log a long voyage of fake joins, but if none of those nodes produce attested answers, every quill-stroke of the invite graph pays its creator exactly zero. Fakes cost real money to run and return nothing.
